ordered_diagnoses: Renal cell carcinoma with adrenal metastasis

s1.syndrome_frame: Acute flank pain with radiating abdominal pain and associated nausea
salient_findings: Sudden, dull left flank pain radiating to the lateral abdomen
Tenderness at the left costovertebral angle
7 cm × 5 cm × 5 cm heterogenous left adrenal mass with local extension and invasion into surrounding structures
key_facts: Female patient in her mid-60s
Sudden onset of dull left flank pain
Pain radiates to the lateral abdomen
Nausea accompanying the pain
No exacerbating or alleviating factors noted
Family history of renal cell carcinoma
Medical history of hypertension, basal cell carcinoma, and an autoimmune condition
Long-term azathioprine therapy
Hemoglobin of 114 g/L
WBC of 6.17 ×10⁹/L
ESR of 54 mm/hr
CT scan showing a 7 cm × 5 cm × 5 cm heterogenous left adrenal mass
Mass contains regions of necrosis and invades surrounding structures
Presence of multiple enlarged regional lymph nodes
